Answer: C
Reason: Although the automated report generator described normal findings, visual inspection of Figure 1 reveals a distinct, well-circumscribed round soft-tissue mass in the right superior mediastinum/paratracheal region, and Figure 2 confirms increased retrotracheal density consistent with a posterior mediastinal lesion; this morphology and location are characteristic of a duplication cyst (Option C), whereas lipomas would appear radiolucent and neurofibromas typically present as lobulated masses often associated with rib changes not seen here. *(guided by t000003)*
